standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: Do you have anything of importance to say?
You will have to excuse me, then. I am very busy as I have a kingdom to run!

standard-dialogue-talking-to-king-roald-.npc: Well hello there. What do you want?
Ah, it's you again. Hello there.
Do you have anything of importance to say?
You will have to excuse me, then. I am very busy as I have a kingdom to run!

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril.npc: Yes, citizen. Do you need something?

options.text: About that job you gave me...

steps.player: About that job you gave me...

steps.npc: Ah, yes, we recieved word from Drezel. I hear the Salve is safe once more. Very good work!

steps.player: Thank you. Will you be sending some soldiers over to sort out those Zamorakians?

steps.npc: Yes, yes, we'll make sure they're dealt with. Might take a little while, mind you. Lots of priorities to balance around here. I'm sure we'll have them gone before the end of the year though.
You will have to excuse me then. I am very busy as I have a kingdom to run!

standard-dialogue-after-the-blood-moon-r.npc: Yes, citizen. Do you need something?

steps.npc: Couldn't be better! After all that fearmongering from you, citizen, it turned out they actually wanted to be friends! Good job you're not the King.
Yes, I agree! It's very good indeed.

steps.speaker: Aeonisig Raispher
steps.text: I do still feel that we should reconsider this new alliance, my lord. Vampyres are beasts of Zamorak!

steps.npc: Well, you were very worried about those Guthixian edicts, Aeonisig. Surely with this new alliance, we've managed to achieve the perfect balance those Guthixians always wanted!

steps.speaker: Aeonisig Raispher
steps.text: Yes, but the Church of Saradomin...

steps.npc: Oh, don't worry yourself, Aeonisig. It's not like we'll be inviting any of them over any time soon. No, this new arrangement is perfect. We can be all be friends, but just from a safe and healthy distance!
Anyway, what was it you wanted, citizen?

steps.player: You know, I think I'll actually be on my way...

steps.npc: You will have to excuse me, then. I am very busy as I have a kingdom to run!

treasure-trails-medium.npc: Is there a reason for you being here?

treasure-trails-medium.player: Well, I'm on a treasure trail...

treasure-trails-medium.npc: Oh! Good, then you can answer this question for me!

treasure-trails-medium-when-spoken-to-ag.npc: Please enter the answer to the question.

steps.npc: Err, that sounds a little wrong to me.

steps.text: King Roald has given you another clue scroll!
